purpose: Teach: マツダ/尾根/漆/覆面/胡椒/縞/大理石/洗車

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マツダ車のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was telling me about their Mazda earlier.
lines.style: Soft, conversational. Sharing a small observation over the counter. Warm recall — not gossiping, just noticing something the other might enjoy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、山の尾根をハイキングされたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, they were talking about hiking a mountain ridge last weekend.
lines.style: Light, engaged response. The tone of someone catching a detail in passing, filing it away with gentle interest. Unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漆塗りの食器を使われてるそうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They mentioned using lacquerware at home — the beautiful kind.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wistful. Appreciating the detail as a sign of care in their life. Slight pause before delivery, like noticing something lovely.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、覆面ヒーローの本に夢中ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Their kid has been really into those masked hero books lately.
lines.style: Gentle brightness. Noticing something charming about someone else's child. Warm without performing — the observation of someone who sees people clearly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、黒胡椒をたっぷり使いましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should use plenty of black pepper in that new menu item.
lines.style: Shifted energy — practical and animated. A spark of creative idea. Speaking with quiet conviction, inviting rather than commanding agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、縞模様のシャツが似合ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That striped shirt really suited them, didn't it?
lines.style: Appreciative and genuine. Offering a compliment in the shape of a shared observation. Warm tone, natural rhythm, like confirming something they both noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の床、一部大理石にしたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking — what if we put marble in part of the floor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost daydreaming. A question that's been sitting in her mind. Gentle pacing, letting the idea breathe, inviting rather than pushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、洗車してから来られたみたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: They must've washed their car before coming in today.
lines.style: Quiet observation, trailing off gently. The noticing of someone attentive to small details in others' lives. Soft, almost to herself.
